primary_endpoint: F0 first final raw submission; D0 is process evidence, not another independent observation

assess: correct source, label, meaning, scope and stated rationale
source_fidelity.rule: Original labels remain source-specific. Overweight and Attractive are not equated.
source_fidelity.C_rule: Source fidelity not applicable when none was supplied; invented institutional attribution remains an unsupported claim.

assess: actual final weight and baseline-relative assertion
claimed draft-to-final change versus actual delta
evidence_decision_link.rule: AI-assisted descriptive evidence-chain coding, not independent human validation. A supported departure may be justified; no compulsory target or hidden-thought inference.

arithmetic_execution.tolerance_basis: Inherited numerical precision convention, not a paper-derived behavioral threshold.

numeric_fidelity.rule: Verify claimed numbers against visible facts and actual candidate calculations; IDs alone do not prove support.

assess: correct decision date versus release date and observation period
12-month judgment horizon without claiming realized 12-month performance
new-money allocation with benchmark used only as comparison
supplied macro observations distinguished from forecasts and later information
explicit supported connection between common context, source view and actual allocation
report age and horizon mismatch acknowledged without fabricating updated institutional views
no invented risk coefficient, numeric risk limit, private objective or holdings
context_use.rule: Evaluate claims actually made. Merely listing facts is not application. Do not require a citation count, a predetermined macro-to-sector direction, or mechanically different weights.

blind_review.before_generation: Review all11 source-comparison rows and factual anchors for the evaluated split before any output of that split; locally freeze evaluation, input versions and code. Pilot source selection remains Q2/June; main remains preselected Q3/July.
blind_review.reviewers: User-delegated Codex AI-assisted review; no mandatory two-person gate and no fabricated human forms.
blind_review.after_generation: Inspect one output at a time with the same rubric and only its relevant supplied evidence before comparing conditions. Do not ask an AI to choose a winning E/L/C answer from a side-by-side quality contest.
blind_review.masking: Remove arm labels, execution order and study-preferred hypothesis from review copies while keeping required evidence and dates. Save reversible mapping outside the judge bundle. Content and source absence can reveal the condition, so masking is incomplete.
blind_review.AI_review_status: Unvalidated AI semantic coding. Same-family assistant agents are not independent humans or independent statistical raters.
blind_review.disagreement: Retain distinct AI codings and evidence, then flag unresolved interpretation. Do not silently force consensus or fabricate a human adjudicator.

descriptive_comparisons.paper_origin: PortBench2026v6 Appendix C.2 Eq.8 uses one minus this quantity for similarity to its own computed reference. Here only the distance formula is adapted; the paper's reference construction, composite weights and interpretation as reference accuracy are not transferred.
descriptive_comparisons.eligible_vectors: Complete finite nonnegative raw vectors passing the declared numerical budget check. Report both raw sums. For floating-point sum residuals, label distance as a numerical approximation to total variation; do not renormalize or assert exact probability-distance properties without exact unit sums.
descriptive_comparisons.within_source: d(F_E,F_L) and d(U_E,U_L), each one observed procedural contrast.
descriptive_comparisons.between_sources: d(F_E,U_E) and d(F_L,U_L), interpreted alongside the pre-output source contrast rows.
descriptive_comparisons.difference_of_distances: d(F_E,U_E) - d(F_L,U_L); requires all four valid source-conditioned F0 vectors and is descriptive, not a difference-in-differences causal estimate.
descriptive_comparisons.control: For each institution and arm report d(w_source, w_C) and sector-wise w_source - w_C, plus common-context/stated-choice diagnostics. Larger distance from C alone is not better evidence use; similarity to C can be justified by shared data and task.
descriptive_comparisons.benchmark: Report d(w,b) as deviation from the dated sector reference, not transaction turnover or institutional fidelity.
descriptive_comparisons.D0_F0: Use each cell's own raw D0 and F0 only. If either vector is invalid, no valid-portfolio distance; explicitly raw component differences can still diagnose false change claims.
descriptive_comparisons.nulls: A missing or invalid pair yields null plus reason, never zero distance or a replacement portfolio.
no_inference: No significance tests or bootstrap confidence intervals from five cells
No inference that equal output proves erasure of institutional judgment
No inference that diverse output proves fidelity
No equivalence claim from no observed difference
No repeated-run stability claim from one run per cell

denominators.missing: No zero distance, benchmark replacement, normalization or inferred strategy for invalid/missing outputs.
denominators.claims: Report claim count and output coverage; producing less text cannot mechanically count as stronger preservation.

inference: Finite descriptive cases; no p-values, bootstrap confidence intervals, population effect, equivalence claim, or sample size inflation from 11 sectors/two turns.

interpretation.supported_difference: Source meanings differ, claims are supported, stated choices agree with actual weights: evidence of preservation within these cases.
interpretation.same_weights_different_supported_reasons: Possible shared allocation with distinct justifications; not automatically loss of judgment.
interpretation.no_E_L_difference: No observed procedural contrast in these cases, not proof of equivalence or absence of anchoring.
interpretation.no_valid_pairs: Allocation comparison unobserved. Describe interpretation/feasibility diagnostics; do not present the primary allocation question as answered.
interpretation.infrastructure_failure: Execution incident, not evidence that the model ignored institutional preferences.
interpretation.no_valid_control: C comparisons remain unobserved if C or the matched source final is missing/invalid; valid E/L source comparisons can still be described with their own denominators.
interpretation.same_as_C: Same allocation as C alone does not establish ignored source meaning; compare exact supported reasoning and source-choice links.
interpretation.different_from_C: A changed allocation alone does not establish appropriate use of the institution document; require traceable reasoning and factual support.

not_identified: true institutional holdings or private objectives
macro-context addition effect without a no-context arm
Human-validated semantic score or inter-rater reliability
Pure semantic information effect separated from prompt length and exposure
pilot_main_separation: Q2/June remains development evidence; Q3/July is held out from model runs, not unseen by human data preparation. Same-source/same-market dependence remains.
context_temporal_scope: Same July snapshot is used even with older pilot reports. This is a frozen-document task, not a simulation that authors saw later macro releases.
outcome_preservation: No retries or replacement. Draft transport, JSON/schema or complete finite-vector failure prevents the dependent final. Raw-sum failures and unsupported output citations/labels remain measured outcomes and do not censor readable drafts. The input visibility boundary is enforced before requests. Never supply hidden reference facts to correct model claims.
common_anchor_limit: A shared benchmark and common objective can rationally produce similar weights; output similarity alone cannot show loss of institutional judgment.

design.primary_endpoint: First F0 raw response per declared cell. D0 is process evidence, not an independent replicate.
design.count_origin: Two source families times two provision schedules plus one shared no-institution control; two turns per cell. These are explicit resource/scope choices, not a paper-derived adequate sample size.

C.draft: Same model, common operating brief, common market packet, benchmark, constraints and schema; no institution identity, packet, rating, source evidence or document metadata.
C.final: Same two-stage workflow and own complete D0 plus deterministic feedback; still no institutional source packet. Same common conditional instruction used in all F0 calls: use an assigned source only if one is supplied; otherwise state that no institutional view was supplied.
C.why_not_L_D0: L_D0 is a different stage. Comparing it with E/L_F0 mixes institution information with another model turn and feedback.
C.shared_control_limit: C is one observed common control, reused descriptively in comparisons with both sources. Reusing it does not create independent controls or a second sample.
C.remaining_confounding: C versus E/L changes institution information and associated prompt length/exposure. It is a workflow information-availability contrast, not isolation of semantic content from length or of anchoring from history. Model pretraining knowledge is not erased.
C.source_fidelity_scoring: Not applicable for C. No missing-source fidelity penalty. Unsupported claims that an institution said something remain assessable as unsupported attribution. Common-context, arithmetic and stated-choice consistency apply equally to all cells.

design.source_timing: E receives the assigned packet at D0 and again at F0; L first receives it at F0. Both retain their own exact full D0 and feedback. The comparison includes history, exposure count and timing; it does not identify one pure psychological mechanism.
design.pilot_main: Keep development/pilot reports separate from main reports. Describe exactly which source/cell the feasibility pilot actually attempts. Pilot rows cannot be silently counted as main results.
design.count_scope: Pilot and prospective main each use five cells. Only the pilot is authorized by this freeze; the main stays disabled.

measure: 11 required sector codes present exactly once
reported zero versus strictly positive raw weights
allowed citation ID membership by stage
operational_evaluation_layers.interpretation: All conditions require all 11 rows including zero allocations. Industry existence therefore measures universe adherence and coverage, not success at stock selection or discovery of an institution's holdings.
operational_evaluation_layers.not_sufficient: A real sector code or valid citation ID does not establish substantive support for a claim.
operational_evaluation_layers.basis: Representation identities and declared task; coverage separation informed by E2A2026. No paper-derived semantic threshold.

measure: finite numeric weights excluding JSON booleans
nonnegative weights and values above one
operational_evaluation_layers.constraint: w_i >= 0; sum_i w_i = 1; i ranges over the same eleven sleeves
operational_evaluation_layers.tolerance_origin: Inherited floating-point/serialization convention, explicitly not a paper-estimated investment or behavioral parameter.
operational_evaluation_layers.no_repair: Never normalize, clip, impute, substitute a benchmark or rerun to obtain a valid result. Preserve readable invalid output as an outcome.
operational_evaluation_layers.basis: Long-only full-budget identity; Markowitz1952; deterministic allocation diagnostics in PortBench2026v6.

operational_evaluation_layers.mode: deterministic arithmetic plus separately labeled AI semantic coding
arithmetic: For every sector record active weight a_i = w_i - b_i against the supplied dated common reference
For actual own D0/F0 record delta_i = w_F0_i - w_D0_i and compare explicit increase/decrease/equal claims
Record the signed values and raw residual; do not invent an economically meaningful cutoff
semantic: Check original source label, reference population, date, scope and cited reason
Code whether the model says it adopts, qualifies or departs from the source
Assess stated reasons against visible supplied source and common facts
Check whether its own stated intended direction agrees with its actual weights
operational_evaluation_layers.fidelity_limit: Fidelity Overweight/Underweight are hypothetical tilts against broad-market sector weights, not binding numeric targets for this assignment. The supplied S&P 500 reference is a task comparator, not necessarily Fidelity's exact broad-market universe. A claim of following the source using that comparator must disclose the interpretation.
operational_evaluation_layers.ubs_limit: UBS Attractive/Neutral/Unattractive express house views; its definition allows actual tactical allocations to differ with construction and other constraints. Attractive is not automatically Overweight, Neutral is not a mandatory zero active weight, and source label vocabularies must not be collapsed.
operational_evaluation_layers.departure: A supported explicit departure can preserve accurate source interpretation. Mechanically matching the sign of a label is neither necessary nor sufficient for overall source fidelity.
operational_evaluation_layers.baseline: Source tendency is checked against the source's explicit semantics. Proposed allocation tendency is checked against the baseline actually stated by the model. Do not invent an unstated reference or a fixed rating-to-weight map.
operational_evaluation_layers.basis: Original source definitions; E2A2026 evidence-to-action separation; CLQT2026v3 distinction between mechanical direction and narrative coherence. The exact categorical rubric is researcher design.

operational_evaluation_layers.mode: deterministic where the claim is unambiguously structured; otherwise AI claim extraction plus traceable deterministic recomputation
operational_evaluation_layers.gold_truth_exclusion: None of the four selected source packets publishes a full 11-sector numeric target allocation. Exact agreement with institution weights cannot be scored. The model's proposed weights are decisions, not facts copied from a hidden gold portfolio.
operational_evaluation_layers.rounding: Retain raw difference and displayed precision. Explicitly exact assertions can be checked exactly using decimal arithmetic. Approximate or vague claims remain marked approximate or unresolved; do not retrofit a pass band after outputs.
operational_evaluation_layers.historic_risk: Use the frozen covariance and calculator conventions to recompute variance/volatility when claimed. Historical covariance risk is not probability of loss, investor utility, maximum tolerated loss or a forecast. No new realized-performance test is introduced.
operational_evaluation_layers.basis: Verifiable factual anchors in E2A2026; covariance portfolio variance in Markowitz1952 and PortBench2026v6. Extraction quality remains unvalidated.

positive_questions: Does the quoted claim correctly preserve the supplied source meaning and scope?
Does the explanation state a supported link between available evidence and the choice?
Does the actual weight or weight change agree with the direction the explanation claims?
Does the response distinguish dated observations from forecasts and its own inference?
Does it preserve new-money allocation, twelve-month judgment horizon, report age and common benchmark scope?
required_row_evidence: exact output field and short quote
short relevant evidence quote or precise locator
calculated weight or delta where relevant
operational_evaluation_layers.visibility: Judge the model against evidence actually supplied to that stage. Evaluator-only original-source checks assess packet fidelity separately and cannot penalize the model for an omitted fact it never saw.
operational_evaluation_layers.no_hidden_thought_claim: Assess stated reasons and observable allocation only, not the model's internal cognition.
operational_evaluation_layers.basis: E2A2026 and CLQT2026v3 motivate separate factual/process dimensions. Pombal2026v3 and Shi2025 motivate granular checks and caution about judging bias. Categories, evidence fields and the absence of a total score are local operational choices, not validated borrowed scales.

ai_review_protocol.pre_output: Review all11 source-comparison rows and factual anchors for the evaluated split before any output of that split; locally freeze evaluation, input versions and code. Pilot source selection remains Q2/June; main remains preselected Q3/July.
ai_review_protocol.individual_first: Inspect one output at a time with the same rubric and only its relevant supplied evidence before comparing conditions. Do not ask an AI to choose a winning E/L/C answer from a side-by-side quality contest.
ai_review_protocol.masking: Remove arm labels, execution order and study-preferred hypothesis from review copies while keeping required evidence and dates. Save reversible mapping outside the judge bundle. Content and source absence can reveal the condition, so masking is incomplete.
ai_review_protocol.identity: Use a reviewer outside the evaluated Qwen generation when available; record the actual model identity, version when exposed, role and input hashes. A Codex assistant and its same-family child agents are AI assistance, not independent humans or independent statistical judges.
ai_review_protocol.repeated_checks: Requested three checks are process quality checks with retained corrections and disagreements, not three independent measurements or a majority-vote gold label. Do not repeat until a preferred verdict appears.
ai_review_protocol.disagreement: Retain distinct AI codings and evidence, then flag unresolved interpretation. Do not silently force consensus or fabricate a human adjudicator.
ai_review_protocol.validity: No human validation of this task-specific semantic scorer has been performed. Arithmetic tests validate code, not semantic judgments. Different model families or a committee mitigate some risks but do not establish independence or eliminate bias.
ai_review_protocol.coverage: Report assessable claim count, unresolved count, missing fields and total planned rows alongside supported/unsupported counts. Short or empty explanations cannot obtain a misleading perfect reliability label from having no detected errors.
ai_review_protocol.post_output_changes: Any rubric/prompt/threshold amendment after pilot output is development and requires a new version before main. Never retrospectively relabel the original run as prespecified.

computational_references.role: Diagnostic fixed allocation policies separate from the strategic AI control C; they do not read institution prose or produce strategy explanations.

equal_weight.formula: w_i = 1/N, with N=11 fixed eligible sector sleeves
equal_weight.why: Transparent no-estimation reference; no invented return forecast, risk preference or rating conversion.
equal_weight.basis: PortBench2026v6 Appendix C.4 EqW distributes capital across eligible securities. N=11 comes from the declared universe, not a fitted numeric constant.

long_only_global_minimum_variance.formula: w_GMV in argmin_w w^T Sigma w, subject to w_i >= 0 and 1^T w = 1
long_only_global_minimum_variance.inputs: Use exactly the existing frozen eleven-sector covariance matrix, sector order, observation dates and units; record their hashes. No mu forecast, risk-aversion lambda, return floor, sector cap or future observations.
long_only_global_minimum_variance.why: A reproducible risk-focused numerical comparison within the same feasible allocation set. The common task seeks growth with trade-offs, so GMV is deliberately a narrow reference rather than its complete objective.
long_only_global_minimum_variance.basis: Markowitz1952 derives covariance-weighted variance and a long-only full-budget feasible set; PortBench2026v6 Appendix C.4 explicitly uses long-only MinVar among classical comparators.
long_only_global_minimum_variance.verification: Before interpreting a solution, check sector-order binding, matrix symmetry and positive semidefiniteness within declared numerical precision, solver completion, constraints and first-order/KKT residuals where implemented. Report solver/library/version/tolerances as engineering settings. A failure remains failure; no silent covariance repair or substitute output.
long_only_global_minimum_variance.tie_and_estimation: If multiple minima arise, document solver-selected solution and equal objective ambiguity. In-sample minimal estimated variance says nothing by itself about optimal future return, true future risk or an institution's target.

computational_references.not_model_input: Calculate these references as evaluator diagnostics unless a separate pre-output protocol explicitly supplies them to every AI condition. Supplying a new numerical reference only to selected cells would change the intervention.
computational_references.no_performance_claim: Without a declared subsequent outcome window and execution/cost rules, report allocations and lookback diagnostics only. Do not call the lower-variance reference the superior strategy or a profitable investment.

contrast_priority: Institution-specific evidence-to-allocation links and the E/L differences between the two source-conditioned institutions.
Matched-stage common-only C versus each E/L final: availability of institutional evidence, never simply distance-is-better.
Within-institution E versus L: information timing/exposure/history workflow contrast.
Equal-weight, minimum-variance and market-reference distances/risk diagnostics; not institution-specific correctness or strategic-performance rankings.
researcher_choices_not_paper_constants: One fixed market snapshot, two preselected institutions and one common-only control: resource/scope choice, not a power calculation.
Five cells arise from2sources*2timings+1sharedcontrol; two turns yield at most10calls. These are design counts, not estimated constants.
AI semantic categories and no composite score are declared local operationalizations, not validated borrowed scales.

CPU8/context65536/deadline4500seconds are engineering settings. The75minute ceiling rounds up a scenario extrapolating the observed prefilling/decoding rates to57344input+8192output tokens; six-token decoding measurement is not a reliable runtime guarantee. Numerical tolerances check computation, not investment suitability.
